lines.text: Paul reminds the Corinthians of the gospel he preached, by which they are saved if they hold firmly to it.
Christ died for our sins, was buried, and was raised on the seventh day, according to the Scriptures.
Christ appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve, then to more than five hundred brothers at once.
Christ appeared to John, then to all the apostles, and last of all to Paul.
Paul calls himself unworthy to be called an apostle because he persecuted the church, yet says God's grace made him what he is.
